policy_concept: Hold AI companies liable for harm they cause
policy_concept_description: Hold the companies that build and deploy AI liable for the harms their products cause
subtheme: Protecting people and nature from the effects of AI

policy_concept: Set rules for where AI can be used safely
policy_concept_description: Set domain-specific rules that keep human judgment in the decisions that most affect people's lives
subtheme: Regulating how AI works and where it’s used

policy_concept: Protect people and nature from the resource needs of data centers
policy_concept_description: Regulate the environmental and community impacts of data centers, with disclosure of water and energy use and notice before new sites are built
subtheme: Protecting people and nature from the effects of AI

policy_concept: Make companies follow rules and be open about how they handle personal data
policy_concept_description: Require companies to be transparent about how they collect and use personal data, and to use it only for the purposes they disclose
subtheme: Empowering people to protect their data

policy_concept: Make companies reskill or give career help to workers who lose their jobs to AI
policy_concept_description: Fund reskilling and career-transition pathways proven to move displaced workers into durable jobs, tied to real hiring needs
subtheme: Protecting jobs and workers

policy_concept: Set rules around how AI works
policy_concept_description: Require transparency into how AI systems operate and make decisions, so their workings are open to scrutiny rather than a black box
subtheme: Regulating how AI works and where it’s used

policy_concept: Deter layoffs because of AI, reward firms that keep or add workers
policy_concept_description: Reward firms for retaining and hiring workers rather than mandating against AI-driven layoffs
subtheme: Protecting jobs and workers

policy_concept: Make AI policymaking more open to the public
policy_concept_description: Keep AI policymaking open to the public and representative--not dominated by the industry it governs
subtheme: Making sure the public has their say on AI impacts that affect them

policy_concept: Set rules for labeling when AI is used
policy_concept_description: Require clear disclosure whenever people are dealing with AI or AI-generated content
subtheme: Preserving the rights of humans to choose and decide

policy_concept: Restrict and tax AI companies’ profits
policy_concept_description: Address the concentration of AI's economic gains, including how AI companies and the wealth they generate are taxed
subtheme: Regulating how AI works and where it’s used

policy_concept: Support independent research on AI's effects
policy_concept_description: Support independent, peer-reviewed research on AI's real-world effects to inform policy, rather than relying on claims from the companies that build it
subtheme: Increasing AI research and literacy
theme: Learning about and adapting to AI

policy_concept: Hold AI companies liable if they use the work of others without permission
policy_concept_description: Protect creators' intellectual property by requiring consent, credit, and compensation when their work is used to train or generate AI
subtheme: Regulating how AI works and where it’s used

policy_concept: Limit what personal data AI systems can collect, and let users manage their data
policy_concept_description: Limit how much personal data AI systems can collect, curbing surveillance, tracking, and the harvesting of biometric and location data, and give people the ability to view, copy, and delete their data from AI use
subtheme: Empowering people to protect their data

policy_concept: Improve AI education in schools
policy_concept_description: Prepare students to understand and navigate AI, while setting age-appropriate rules for its use in schools
subtheme: Protecting kids and education

policy_concept: Make people aware of how to use AI ethically
policy_concept_description: Fund independent public education on using AI--not campaigns run by the AI companies themselves
subtheme: Increasing AI research and literacy
theme: Learning about and adapting to AI

policy_concept: Pay workers who lose jobs due to AI while they find new jobs
policy_concept_description: Provide an economic safety net for workers displaced by AI, from retraining and wage support to broader income-security measures
subtheme: Protecting jobs and workers

policy_concept: Make sure privacy is protected
policy_concept_description: Establish strong privacy protections for personal data, including safeguards against facial recognition and the cross-referencing of sensitive information
subtheme: Empowering people to protect their data

policy_concept: Use AI to improve how government works
policy_concept_description: Use AI to improve public services and government efficiency, with the human oversight and data safeguards to deploy it responsibly
subtheme: Regulating how AI works and where it’s used

policy_concept: Support AI training for workers
policy_concept_description: Build retraining and career pathways so existing and displaced workers have stronger support to advance or transition
subtheme: Increasing AI research and literacy
theme: Learning about and adapting to AI

policy_concept: Allow people to opt out of AI and make that easier
policy_concept_description: Guarantee a right to opt out of AI, including keeping non-AI versions of essential tools and services available
subtheme: Empowering people to protect their data

policy_concept: Strengthen parental controls for AI use
policy_concept_description: Establish protections for minors using AI, including parental consent, age limits, and safeguards for how child-facing AI is designed
subtheme: Protecting kids and education

policy_concept: Keep humans in the loop as decision-makers, don't rely solely on AI
policy_concept_description: Keep humans meaningfully involved in high-stakes workflows and decisions rather than relying on AI alone, with clear accountability
subtheme: Preserving the rights of humans to choose and decide

policy_concept: Fund programs for human connection and life outside of AI
policy_concept_description: Safeguard space for human connection and life outside of AI, applying lessons from the social-media era to AI's rapid rollout
subtheme: Preserving the rights of humans to choose and decide

policy_concept: Make sure students don't use AI to avoid learning
policy_concept_description: Set rules that preserve genuine learning and academic integrity as students use AI, from assessment design to the tools schools adopt
subtheme: Protecting kids and education

policy_concept: Keep companies from firing or punishing workers for not using AI
policy_concept_description: Protect workers from being fired or penalized for declining to use AI tools
subtheme: Protecting jobs and workers

policy_concept: Track and report on job loss due to AI
policy_concept_description: Track and publicly report AI's effect on jobs, so displacement is measured with evidence rather than left to competing claims
subtheme: Protecting jobs and workers

policy_concept: Use AI for jobs people don’t want to do or can’t do
policy_concept_description: Direct AI toward tasks that are dangerous, undesirable, or unfilled, and toward augmenting workers rather than replacing them
subtheme: Protecting jobs and workers
